scope: Fresh serial processes, one warmup then three rotating-order repetitions per input/variant. Native total includes selection, preparation, learning, coding, admission and prepared-frame teardown; reference total is the stock e9 encoder API interval. Learning includes all scope preparation and fits, plus native stage admission, validation and compaction. No input IO, independent source unpack, decode, trace or output IO in measured intervals. No thread pools. Uncontrolled desktop, no concurrent agent builds/tests/encodes. Per-stage native CPU is process CPU with nested time removed.
limits: Three repetitions on one uncontrolled desktop; no statistical confidence interval
Native whole interval covers prepare, coding and teardown; stock uses the encoder API wrapper
Reference patch input has an additional frame and different learning problem
All-predictor native work is a rate/cost control, not identical reference fitting
No new held-out or exhaustive-search qualification
